parameters.text:
=Fitness bot. Send me:

1. A workout note (title line with date if logging a past day, then exercise and "weight x reps" lines).
2. Your weight, e.g. 79.4
3. Tape measurements, e.g. "waist 84.5" or "neck 39, waist 84.5, hips 97" (sites: neck, chest, waist, hips, shoulders, l arm, r arm, l thigh, r thigh, l calf, r calf)
4. A voice note, or text starting "food", saying what you ate with amounts. If I have no label for something I will ask: send a photo of the nutrition table, or reply "no label" for an estimate.
5. A photo of your plate with a caption saying what it is and how much (e.g. "pasta with 1.5 chicken thighs"): I itemise it and log a slightly conservative estimate.

Your chat id is {{ $('Classify').first().json.chatId }}.
=Didn't recognise that. Send a workout note, a weight (e.g. 79.4), "waist 84.5", a food voice note, or /help.
